rpc_backpressure_fixture_followup.fix: The integration test retries only exact structured not-applied backpressure within its cancellation deadline. Request authorization results and all other errors remain observable. Runtime code and publish.yml are unchanged.

queue_lease_fixture_followup.cause: The metadata redelivery fixture used a one-second reservation for cold deserialization and settlement. Native NACK returned NotFound after that reservation was gone.
